requirements.evidence: Nearly the whole contract is implemented: routes entity.queues/entity.serve (routes/web.php:59-60), every Queues property and method (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:24-248), scoped findOrFail everywhere (e.g. Queues.php:99, 145, 200-201), slug re-derived on rename `slug: Str::slug($newName)` (Queues.php:152), a confirmation modal instead of wire:confirm (queues.blade.php:114-136), accessQueue/accessGrants null-safe (Queues.php:232-238), and Serve callNext with the specified notices, uncaught AuthorizationException and a rate limit (Serve.php:102-134). Members tabs and the navbar links are there, and all lang keys exist in both locales. Gap: `CallMode::from($this->mode)` (Serve.php:119) throws ValueError (a 500) when `mode` is tampered, because `mode` is never validated. waitingTickets uses tryFrom, so the two paths behave differently.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through the Actions (CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket), policies are used, the style matches the members page, and CHANGELOG plus docs/business-rules.md are updated. Deviations from the mandatory Livewire policy: helpers are public and so callable from the client (`public function viewingQueue()` Queues.php:220, `public function callableQueues()` Serve.php:50, `selectedQueue()` Serve.php:63, `waitingTickets()` Serve.php:78), against rule 5. No public property has `#[Validate]` (`name`, `renameName`, `mode`, `selectedQueueId`, `activeTab`), against rule 1. grantAccess/revokeAccess have no `$this->authorize` in the component (Queues.php:198-212), against rule 3, although the action authorizes.

security.evidence: No exploitable write found. All client ids resolve scoped to the entity, the actions authorize internally, `lastCalledTicketId` is #[Locked], output uses `{{ }}`, and the tampered-accessQueueId case discloses nothing. Gaps with limited impact: public read helpers (Serve.php:50,63,78; Queues.php:220) are endpoints whose return values Livewire sends back to the caller (they are scoped and gate-filtered, so disclosure is limited). `mode` is unvalidated and causes a 500 at Serve.php:119. grantAccess/revokeAccess rely only on authorization inside the action.

tests.evidence: New QueuesUiTest.php and ServeUiTest.php cover happy paths, the employee 403 on mount and route, duplicate-slug and rename-collision errors, the confirmation modal, grant/revoke, tampered accessQueueId, a foreign openQueue, callNext notices, callNext without a grant (403), locales, the navbar, and the members tabs (MembersTest.php:432-461). Missing: an unauthorized call to each Queues action (only mount is tested for employees), tamper tests for grantAccess with a foreign membership, toggleActive/startRename with a foreign id, editingQueueId and an invalid mode, and the rate limit. The foreign-selection test checks that the *own* queue's ticket code is absent instead of the foreign one (ServeUiTest.php:107-108), which makes it weak. Existing tests were adapted to the tab switch, not weakened.

simplicity.evidence: Direct, reuses the Actions and the policies. Small redundancies: `$this->reset('name'); $this->name = '';` (Queues.php:92-93), and the ValidationException-to-field error-mapping loop is duplicated between create() and rename() (Queues.php:80-86, 154-160).

readability.evidence: Clear names, short methods, docblocks on the untrusted ids (Queues.php:30-50), and Blade that mirrors the members page. The nested-state reset is repeated across openQueue/closeQueue (Queues.php:103-119).

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task: the two components and views, the routes, the navbar, the members tabs, lang keys, CHANGELOG/docs and tests. No unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: The helpers callableQueues/selectedQueue/waitingTickets/viewingQueue are public, so the client can call them as endpoints and receive their return values; the mandatory Livewire policy (rule 5) requires them to be protected/private.

The client-writable `mode` is never validated, so a tampered value makes `CallMode::from` throw a ValueError (HTTP 500) instead of a validation error; a #[Validate('in:any,priority_only,normal_only')] is missing.
Public input properties (name, renameName, selectedQueueId, mode) have no #[Validate] + $this->validate(), contrary to the project's Livewire validation rule.
grantAccess/revokeAccess do not call $this->authorize('manageAccess', $queue) in the component and rely only on SetQueueAccess, unlike every other action on this page.

No unauthorized-call tests for the individual Queues actions and no tamper tests for grantAccess (foreign membership), toggleActive/startRename (foreign id) or editingQueueId, all of which the Livewire definition of done requires.
The foreign-selection test asserts that the entity's own ticket code is absent rather than the foreign queue's ticket, and there is no test for the rate limit or an invalid mode.
The redundant `$this->reset('name'); $this->name = '';` and the error-mapping loop duplicated between create() and rename() could be removed or shared.

review.summary: The change adds the Queues management page, the Serve attendant panel, the members tabs, navbar links, translations, docs and tests. It routes all writes through the domain actions and scopes every client id to the entity. Approval is blocked by violations of the mandatory Livewire security policy: public helper methods are exposed as endpoints, and public input such as `mode` is unvalidated, so a tampered value causes a 500. Unauthorized-call and tamper tests for most Queues actions are also missing, so the change needs revisions before merge.
